Amazon Web Services (AWS), which rents computing power to other companies, is growing 37% a year. briefs.headline: Exxon is near its highest price in a year, helped by high oil prices
briefs.summary: Exxon's stock is up about 55% this year and hit a new one-year high of $183.21 on Oct 23. A big reason is that oil prices have been high because of fighting in the Middle East, which helps every oil company. Exxon is also pumping record amounts of oil in Texas and off the coast of Guyana in South America. The worry: if oil prices drop, a lot of these gains could go away.

briefs.headline: Coca-Cola is up a lot this year, but people are buying fewer drinks
briefs.summary: Coca-Cola's stock is up about 33% this year, almost three times as much as the S&P 500. Coke can raise prices and people keep buying, which is a big strength. But in North America and Europe people are buying fewer drinks, and the stock now costs more compared with its profits than most stocks. Its next results come out Oct 27.

A bank lowered its price goal and questioned whether AI spending will last, the government started looking into farm equipment prices, and tariffs are adding costs.

briefs.headline: Disney's parks and streaming are growing, but investors still aren't sure
briefs.summary: Disney's stock dropped more than 10% from its August high, to about $101 in early October, because investors worry about how fast it can grow. Since then it has bounced back to about $112. Its parks and Disney+ are both growing, and some big banks think the stock is a bargain. Disney is also reportedly combining its TV groups and cutting hundreds of jobs.

bear: Sales came in lower than experts expected in three of the last five quarters
